name: Cross-pool inventory imbalance fade
hypothesis: Pair cheap-pool buying and dear-pool selling using prepositioned inventory after net quotes confirm a sufficient gap.
spec: Setup: A temporary imbalance across venues can normalize without broad market repricing. Entry: Pair cheap-pool buying and dear-pool selling using prepositioned inventory after net quotes confirm a sufficient gap. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Rebalance only under modeled costs after the spread closes. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs synchronized multi-pool DEX quotes (not connected)
